events.name: Bash
events.head: Check branch state and rig page
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -1 main; git log --oneline main..HEAD | head; ls app/public/design/card-variants.html; wc -l app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.module.css; grep -n "Ticket\|class=\"a\|\.a-\|stub\|tear" app/public/design/card-variants.html | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare branches and read deploy script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git rev-list --count HEAD..main; git rev-list --count main..HEAD; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; git worktree list | head; sed -n 1,40p cloud/scripts/deploy-clean.sh | grep -v '^\s*$' | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin/main vs HEAD for centre files
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin main; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD; git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main; git diff --stat HEAD origin/main -- app/src/app/onboarding/centre app/public/design | tail -3; git status --short app/src/app/onboarding/centre | head; ls app/scripts | grep -i "rail-pins\|day-model\|visual\|probe" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find probe scripts and their usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts | grep -i "day-model\|visual\|shot\|critic\|card" ; head -15 app/scripts/check-rail-pins.mjs; f=$(ls app/scripts/*day-model* 2>/dev/null; ls cloud/scripts/*day-model* 2>/dev/null); echo "$f"; head -12 $f

events.text: Now set up a main worktree and read the card render code.

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git merge-base --is-ancestor main origin/main && git branch -f main origin/main && git worktree add -q /private/tmp/t478 main && cd /private/tmp/t478 && git log --oneline -1 && cp -cR /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && echo ok; grep -n "className={s\.\|kind ===\|kind==" app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx | head -80
